Definition: from G2596 and G5613; just (or inasmuch) as, that:--according to, (according, even) as, how, when.
BiblicalUsage: Kathos means just as, even as, the little word that ties one thing to another. Romans 15:21 quotes it as it is written, to whom he was not spoken of, they shall see, and 1 Corinthians 1:6 says even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that as is the hinge of the gospel: what God promised, he did, and what Christ did, he confirms in us.
